acceptanceCriteria: behavior.expect records toBeVisible, toBeHidden, toBeEnabled and toBeChecked (closed set) with a canonical value, and a passing matcher yields an assertion event that behavior-adapter matches as equal (tests).
The behavior-annotation contract (docs/specs/documentation-corpus-v1.md, docs/DOCUMENTATION-CORPUS.md) lists the closed state-matcher set and canonical values.
body: Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#845 (2026-10-12). behavior.expect in internal/doccorpus/behavior-events.cjs records only string matchers and toHaveCount, so outcomes using toBeVisible/toBeHidden/toBeEnabled/toBeChecked never get an equal assertion event and behavior-adapter reports semantic-mismatch. Expected: a closed set of state matchers each recorded with a canonical value (the state name), documented in the behavior-annotation contract.
title: behavior-events producer cannot record valueless state matchers like toBeVisible (GitHub #845)
